bars.description: Play the opening pickup and bars 1–8, repeat the middle eight-bar span from the last quarter of bar 8 up to (but not including) the last quarter of bar 16, then continue to bar 24. The central repeat uses exact quarter offsets, not a whole-bar substitute.
